description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).
Hand-built wavefront DP for Levenshtein distance: 18 blocks (no LayerNorm), cells in thermometer code stored at the b-positions, one anti-diagonal per block, exact ReLU min.
Wavefront Levenshtein v1 minus the second copy head: diagonal neighbour reuses the previous block's LEFT copy (d_model 400, 2 heads, 18 blocks, no LayerNorm).
Wavefront v2 with attention sharpness halved (S=283, logit gap ~20) to test how soft the hard-max copy heads can be.
Wavefront v2 with attention sharpness cut to S=57 (logit gap ~4): stress test of how soft the copy/fetch heads can be before exact matching fails.
Wavefront v2 with attention sharpness S=142 (logit gap ~10): finding the transition between S=57 (fails) and S=283 (exact).
Wavefront v2 at S=142 with the border gating removed (BIG=0): ablation to check whether the interior min-units must be silenced on border positions.
Wavefront v2 at S=142 with the border gate reduced to the minimum that silences interior units (BIG=1).
Wavefront v2 at S=142 with the border gate set to BIG=0.5, below the BIG=1 threshold: tests whether half-strength gating still silences the interior units.
Wavefront v2 with attention sharpness S=85 (logit gap ~6), mapping the sharpness boundary between S=57 (fails) and S=142 (exact).
Wavefront v2 with attention sharpness S=110 (logit gap ~8), refining the sharpness boundary between S=85 (76%) and S=142 (exact).
Wavefront v2 with attention sharpness S=125 (logit gap ~9), filling in the sharpness curve between S=110 (99%) and S=142 (exact).
Wavefront v2 with attention sharpness S=100 (logit gap ~7), on the sharpness curve between S=85 (76%) and S=110 (99%).
Wavefront v2 at S=142 with border gate BIG=2 (double the minimum): checks that stronger gating does not hurt.
Wavefront v2 at S=142 with border gate BIG=5: large gate, checks that very strong gating does not hurt.
Wavefront v2 (S=142, BIG=5) with MLP width cut to 29 = exactly the number of hidden units the circuit uses per block.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=105 (logit gap ~7.4), on the sharpness curve between S=100 (93.5%) and S=110 (99%).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=115 (logit gap ~8), on the sharpness curve between S=110 (99%) and S=125 (exact).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=90 (logit gap ~6.4), on the sharpness curve between S=85 (76%) and S=100 (93.5%).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=95 (logit gap ~6.7), on the sharpness curve between S=90 (82.5%) and S=100 (93.5%).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=120 (logit gap ~8.5), on the sharpness curve between S=115 (99%) and S=125 (exact).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=80 (logit gap ~5.7), below the S=85 point (76%) on the sharpness curve.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=70 (logit gap ~5), continuing the sharpness curve below S=80 (68%).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=65 (logit gap ~4.6), continuing the sharpness curve below S=70 (45%).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=60 (logit gap ~4.2), continuing the sharpness curve below S=65 (33.5%).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=50 (logit gap ~3.5), continuing the sharpness curve below S=60 (27%).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=75 (logit gap ~5.3), between S=70 (45%) and S=80 (68%) on the sharpness curve.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=55 (logit gap ~3.9), between S=50 (17.5%) and S=60 (27%) on the sharpness curve.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=45 (logit gap ~3.2), extending the low-sharpness end of the curve below S=50 (17.5%).
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=130 (logit gap ~9.2), on the exact plateau above S=125.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=400 (logit gap ~28): near-hard attention, the upper end of the sharpness sweep.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=800 (logit gap ~57): essentially hard attention, checking for numerical issues at the top of the sweep.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=200 (logit gap ~14), in the saturated range between S=130 and S=400.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=150 (logit gap ~10.6), between S=142 and S=200 on the exact plateau.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=5, d_ff=40) with attention sharpness S=35 (logit gap ~2.5), the lowest point of the sharpness sweep.
Wavefront v2 at S=150 (exact regime) with border gate BIG=1.5, between the threshold BIG=1 and the default BIG=5.
Wavefront v2 at S=150 (exact regime) with border gate BIG=3, between BIG=1.5 and BIG=5.
Wavefront v2 at S=150 (exact regime) with border gate BIG=10: very strong gating, above the default BIG=5.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=10) with attention sharpness S=135 (logit gap ~9.5), between S=125 and S=142 on the exact plateau.
Wavefront v2 (BIG=10) with attention sharpness S=30 (logit gap ~2.1), the lowest point of the sharpness sweep.
Wavefront v2 (S=142, BIG=5) with MLP width 40: spare hidden units left at zero weight, checking that unused capacity is harmless.
